title: MoreFish
description: Vanilla-styled marine life with unique mechanics! Dive in to meet apex predators like Great Whites and roaming Orcas.
body:
A marine mob mod developed for Minecraft Java Forge 1.20.1! It currently features 17 ocean creatures like Great White Sharks, Whale Sharks, and Orcas, with even more new mobs planned for future updates. Most of the creatures can be tamed using specific methods and offer unique functional mechanics—assisting in combat, healing, or providing buffs, they’ve got you covered. With a flexible following system, your tamed companions will never easily abandon you.

本模组基于 Minecraft Java Forge 1.20.1 开发，是一款海洋生物拓展模组。目前实装了 17种 海洋生物，包括大白鲨、鲸鲨、虎鲸等，后续版本将持续更新加入新物种。绝大多数生物均可通过特定方式驯服，并且自带实用的工具属性——无论是协助战斗、生命恢复，还是提供 Buff 加成，它们都能胜任。此外，模组加入了灵活的跟随机制，让你的海洋伙伴不会轻易走丢或卡地丢失。
